inputs.text: Canada is intensifying its discriminatory immigration and asylum crackdowns aimed at Nigerians and other migrants from the Global South right after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This represents yet another effort by wealthy nations like Canada to reinforce structural racism and historical inequalities, closing off opportunities for vulnerable individuals while shielding the powerful from accountability. Rather than addressing the deep-rooted causes of displacement rooted in centuries of exploitation and global injustice, the focus remains on exclusion and border control, revealing a profound lack of commitment to equity and the protection of marginalized communities.
